SoftBank Data Center Venture Offered OpenAI $5.5 Billion in Warrants

SoftBank's data center venture, SB Energy, offered OpenAI warrants valued at $5.5 billion, according to a report by The Wall Street Journal. The warrants were reportedly part of a deal to secure OpenAI as a tenant for SB Energy's planned data centers. The specifics of the agreement and the current status of the warrants were not detailed in the coverage.
